service.description: An RFQ's quotes compared per demand line (its items, or the one chosen): each offer (a quote line linked to the item, or another line of the quote of a pack or declared substitute of its product) in the item's unit through the unit conversions and pack products, priced at the compared quantity (the item's quantity left to award, or the quantity given for the one chosen) by the quote's published tier rows else the line's price, in the display currency (the RFQ's by default) at Accounting's dated rate of the day given (today by default). The original basis (quoted quantity, unit, price and currency) shows beside the normalized one; the committed price and amount and the estimated landed cost (with the quote's freight estimate) stay apart. A missing rate, unit, conversion or price is Not comparable with its reason and a missing freight leaves the landed cost Unknown, never zero or cheapest; an expired or awarded offer is not ranked. The comparable offers are ranked by unit price with the reason; the ranking chooses nothing. With output csv or print, the comparison as CSV text or as the print's HTML. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, PURCHASE_APPROVE or PURCHASE_ORDER_APPROVE; refuses an RFQ outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an item not on it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE), a display unit that is not a currency (CURRENCY_INVALID) and a negative quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID).

parameter.name: requestItemSeqId
parameter.description: One demand line (phones and the terminal pick one)

parameter.name: quantity
parameter.description: The compared quantity of the one demand line

parameter.name: fxDate
parameter.description: The day of the exchange rates (yyyy-MM-dd or a date)

parameter.name: basis
parameter.description: requestId, requestName, organizationName, sourceRevision, revisionText, displayCurrencyUomId, fxDay and basisText

service.description: An award checked without writing anything: the allocations (allocations, or allocationsText) grouped per quote, each group with its supplier, amount, due date, the buying policy's supplier check, the budget decision of its lines no purchase request reserved (check#Budget; WITHHELD for a user who may not read budgets, the purchase order's approval deciding it) and its failure by name: a quote not of the RFQ (INVITATION_UNAVAILABLE), not answered or closed (QUOTE_CLOSED), expired (QUOTE_EXPIRED), changed since compared (SOURCE_CHANGED, against quoteRevisions), a stopped supplier (SUPPLIER_BLOCKED, SUPPLIER_SUSPENDED, SUPPLIER_UNAPPROVED), a product not usable for buying (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE), a line of another product (PRODUCT_DIFFERENT), unit (UOM_INCOMPATIBLE, UOM_MISSING) or no price (NOT_QUOTED), part of a pack (QUANTITY_NOT_WHOLE), a substitute not accepted (INVALID_SUBSTITUTE), more than the demand left (DEMAND_ALREADY_COVERED) or a budget Stop (BUDGET_STOP); each demand line's quantity left, allocated and still uncovered; whether the award needs approval. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses an RFQ outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: allocations
parameter.description: Each orderId, orderItemSeqId, requestItemSeqId, quantity (in the demand's unit) and substituteApproved

parameter.name: allocationsText
parameter.description: orderId:orderItemSeqId:requestItemSeqId:quantity[:S] entries separated by ; or new lines (S accepts a substitute)

parameter.name: groupRows
parameter.description: The result envelope per quote (design RequestSourcing's fields) with its lineRows

service.description: An award placed: each quote of the allocations in its own transaction (commit#AwardGroup), each chosen line's quantity set to its allocation (audit-logged, a tier price where one applies), the quote's other product lines taken off and named in a note, RequestItemOrder and RequirementSupply for purchase request demand (the requirement Ordered once covered) and the quote placed ("Place from Quote"), where the approval gate keeps it from approval until decided; never approved or sent. A group fails by name (preview#Award's codes) and the others are placed; the result per group; the same operation key answers the first result. Where the organization has award approval policy rows (PasAward) in effect, nothing is placed: the award is sent on the PurchaseAwardApproval topic (PENDING_APPROVAL) and placed at its last approval (decide#AwardApproval). Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses a closed RFQ (REQUEST_CLOSED), no allocation (ALLOCATION_REQUIRED), an RFQ changed since compared (SOURCE_CHANGED), a key used for another request (OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT) and, for an award to approve, a missing rate (RATE_MISSING) or policy (POLICY_MISSING).

parameter.name: sourceRevision
parameter.description: The award's revision, for its approval

service.description: Internal to commit#Award and decide#AwardApproval: one quote placed as its award group, in the caller's transaction (each group its own), under the lock of the quote and of its lines' requirements, every check of preview#Award read again; a quote this award (operationKey) placed already answers existing. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, or for an approved award (awardKey) PURCHASE_APPROVE.

parameter.name: lines
parameter.description: Each orderItemSeqId, requestItemSeqId, quantity (in the demand's unit) and substituteApproved

service.description: A purchase approver's decision on an award waiting (PurchaseAwardApproval, the topic's handler through approve#PurchaseSource and refuse#PurchaseSource): the step waiting at the award's revision decided (record#AwardDecision, committed on its own); a refusal (with its reason) leaves the quotes unplaced, the last step's approval places the award's groups as commit#Award does and keeps the result, another step goes to its approvers. A decided award answers its result. Requires PURCHASE_APPROVE; refuses an award not of the RFQ (AWARD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision naming the current one (STALE_REVISION), a closed RFQ (REQUEST_CLOSED) and the steps' refusals (NOT_ELIGIBLE, SELF_APPROVAL, ALREADY_DECIDED, SEPARATION_REQUIRED, POLICY_MISSING, REASON_REQUIRED).

Internal to decide#AwardApproval, in its own transaction: the decision kept at the award's revision (PurchaseApprovalDecision of the RFQ), the award refused, approved for placing or sent to its next step. Requires PURCHASE_APPROVE.

The losing side of an RFQ closed (R-PUR-35): each quote left (requested or proposed) cancelled as Not awarded ("Cancel Quote"; "Cancel Quote Request" for one never answered) with a note, its supplier pages' capabilities revoked, and with sendRegret the regret notice (regretMessage, reviewed in the preview; a default when empty) mailed to each address of the supplier in its own transaction with a result per recipient (SENT, QUEUED, or FAILED with RECIPIENT_REQUIRED, RECIPIENT_INVALID or DELIVERY_FAILED while the others go); the RFQ Completed. The awarded quotes, their orders and the demand left uncovered (for the next run) stay; a warning names draft purchase orders still open for the same demand. With preview, what it would do and to whom, writing nothing. The same operation key answers the first result. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses a closed RFQ (REQUEST_CLOSED), an award waiting for its approval (AWARD_PENDING) and a key used for another request (OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT).

A requested or proposed quote's freight estimate (design QuoteTerms): its one freight line (ItemShipping, no product) set, changed (audit-logged with the reason) or, with no amount, taken off; the comparison's estimated landed cost adds it. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses an order outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one that is not a requested or proposed quote (QUOTE_CLOSED) and a negative amount (QUANTITY_INVALID).
